topic: Mastering the Product and Chain Rules in Calculus

sections.title: Prerequisite Warm-up: The Concept of Change
lecture_lines: Derivative represents the rate of change.
Visualizing functions as moving, changing parts.
The runner changes based on combined functions.
animations: Expand the point into a dynamic curve using #3498DB color.
Highlight the tangent line slope #E74C3C moving along curve.

sections.title: The Product Rule: The Collaborative Effort
lecture_lines: Product rule handles multiplying two functions.
Think of a rectangle expanding in area.
Change equals the sum of two strips.
animations: Show product f(x)*g(x) as two interacting #2ECC71 blocks.
Add f(x)*g'(x) to complete the sum in #E67E22.

sections.title: The Chain Rule: The Nested Function
lecture_lines: Chain rule solves nested function derivatives.
Think of opening a Matryoshka doll.
Account for every layer of change.
animations: Nest two gears representing f(g(x)) in #9B59B6.
Rotate outer gear #E91E63 to show chain dependence.
Combine the derivatives with a multiplier path #1ABC9C.

sections.title: Synthesis & Complex Application
lecture_lines: Identify product or chain rule first.
Break it down into logical steps.
animations: Break down parts into identifiable colors #3498DB and #E74C3C.

sections.title: Quick Review & Visual Summary
lecture_lines: Quick summary of core differentiation rules.
Product rule involves adding two terms.
